title: Page 9
content_zh:
按理说，距顾惜恩小产已过了五年，她也才刚满二十岁，原平之也才二十八岁，他们夫妻俩还有足够的时间去等待自己下一个孩子。

但顾惜恩却不这么想，她的压力一年重过一年，她既伤感自己无意中失去的第一个孩子，又急切盼望再有一个新宝宝来抚平心底的创痕，可是越急切期盼就越是怀不上。

原平之虽然也喜欢孩子，却并不是那么迫切，可是他已经不知道该怎么安慰忧思过度的妻子了。

燕京 原府。

新的原府很多主体建筑并没有建造好，只把原平之夫妻俩居住的藤萝馆先建起来。

原平之很钟爱紫藤萝，在这里也移栽了许多，新的院子仍然叫做藤萝馆，这多少缓解了一点顾惜恩的思乡之情。

正值末春午后，吃过午饭的人们都懒洋洋的，顾惜恩在紫藤萝棚架下的秋千上呆坐着，仰望着比南方更蔚蓝的天空。

她的手里捏着一封信，是顾景宏寄给她的，随信寄来的还有一大包药草和一张偏方，给女子调养身体的偏方，据说有利于生养。

顾景宏毕竟不好意思大谈特谈这种事，只在信中含混的说这是以前顾惜恩的祖母为升平大长公主多年不孕而特意寻找过的偏方，金陵也有不少贵妇服用过，据说很有效。

顾惜恩却知道这哪里是祖母找的，根本就是父亲特意为自己寻访的偏方吧？没想到她迟迟不孕的事甚至已经惊动了金陵，惊动了父亲。

那么，想必公公婆婆也关注很久了吧？当年自己的祖父母就是因为母亲迟迟不怀孕而排斥她，那么现在公公婆婆会不会排斥自己呢？他们会不会想替夫君收房纳妾，安排新人？

顾惜恩想得头疼，想着想着就为天下的女子而悲哀，为自己的母亲而悲哀，为自己而悲哀。

她们活着的意义是什么？就为了嫁人生子吗？一旦不能生孩子，尤其是不能生儿子，就成了被人唾弃的废物吗？

现在顾惜恩甚至为自己和原平之是待在燕京而感到庆幸，远离原府那么一大家子人，她不用每天面对公婆，不用面对子女成行的妯娌们，就算公婆对自己不满，妯娌们同情可怜自己，她都可以眼不见为净。

秋水和秋月陪着顾惜恩，秋水已经是两个男孩的娘，秋月也有了个女儿，当年她的陪嫁大丫鬟，如今都已成了独当一面的管事娘子，也都真正做了娘。

现在顾惜恩甚至都有些羡慕自己的丫鬟。

见顾惜恩一直发呆，秋水有些着急，道：「少夫人，现在您连药也懒得吃了，这样拖下去总不是个办法吧？夫妻夫妻，什么叫夫妻？至亲至疏夫妻，这还是奴婢以前听大长公主念过的诗呢！两口子，说亲近是真亲近，住一个屋睡一个床，两个人能好成一个；可要说疏远那还真疏远，没成亲的话根本就是两个陌生人，没血缘的牵绊，说远就远，还远得没边没际的。」

顾惜恩白她一眼，说：「你这些年长进了，说起道理来都挺有道理。」

秋水嘿嘿一笑，生完两个孩子，她的身材发福许多，胖了，性子也越发直爽泼辣，用她自己的话形容就是：「做姑娘的时候很害羞，做小媳妇有点害羞，成了孩子娘就完全不知道羞耻为何物了。」

顾惜恩有时候很看不惯她这样，警告她就算为人妇为人母也要注意仪表和形象，她却根本不在乎，依然朝着俗辣熟妇的形象大步迈进。

第10章(2)

秋月道：「你是越来越啰唆，有话直说，别扯那么多有的没的。」

秋水长叹一声，说：「真是的，奴婢也是为少夫人操心啊。现在的世道就这样，当家主母如果没有一子傍身也是日子艰难，你看看哪家后院不这样？如果被小妾先生了儿子，那日子才叫水深火热呢。」

秋月皱眉，说：「你快打住，说重点！」

「重点就是少夫人得快点生个儿子啊！没有儿子，先生个女儿也成啊，先开花后结果嘛。不管怎么说，先有个孩子，这孩子是夫妻俩的，叫你娘，叫他爹，爹爹娘亲一叫，能让夫妻俩心里比蜜还甜，血缘的牵绊不就有了吗？关系不就更亲密了吗？两口子也不用大眼瞪小眼的无聊度日了。」秋水语重心长地劝道。

秋月掐了她一把，这个自以为聪明的家伙，长篇大论都是废话，她们小姐哪会不想要孩子？

问题是顾惜恩总也怀不上，这才叫伤心绝望好不好？现在秋水还火上浇油，真是找死喔！

顾惜恩听了她的话，沉默良久，却忽然释然一笑：秋水说的很对，她说的是世间夫妻的普遍情况，可是万事总有例外吧？

这些年，原平之一直劝她放松心情，且不说他们还年轻，还有大把的时间能要孩子，就算真的不能再生育了，他们也已经有了个儿子原嘉铭，还担心什么呢？

是啊，还担心什么呢？

人总是太贪心了，才会烦恼不休。

恍然顿悟后，顾惜恩突然之间就放下了沉重的心理包袱，她笑眯眯地站起身，说：「走，回屋。」

晚上原平之回府，听说自家娘子不仅停了所有汤药，还把这些年

娘子不会受什么刺激了吧？

不会是走火入魔了吧？

入睡前，原平之小心翼翼地观察着顾惜恩，见她神色平和，表情愉悦，是这两年来难得一见的轻松模样，大为好奇。

他揽住顾惜恩，笑着问：「娘子，今夜还要不要努力？」

为了让顾惜恩怀孕，他差不多要夜夜奋战，辛苦得很，再这样下去他都担心自己要早衰了。

顾惜恩钻进他怀里，歉疚地拒绝，说：「不要了，夫君白日辛苦一天，需要好好的休息休息了。」

原平之暗中长长舒了口气，总算能轻松一下了。

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

原平之暗暗想，难怪那么多男人找外室，应付妻子有时候真的身心疲累，让人很想逃离。

「听说你把汤药停了？」原平之又问。

「嗯。」顾惜恩懒洋洋地伸了伸腿，在夫君的怀里寻找舒服的姿势，说：「我想开啦，太医说我的身子已经调养得差不多了，根本不用再吃那些乱七八糟的偏方。与其难受，不如顺其自然。我啊，命中有子就终归会有，命中无子也不强求了。」

原平之轻轻抚摸着她的秀发，问：「真的想开了？」

「真的！」顾惜恩抱紧他，喃喃地说：「害你也跟着受累，都是我太任性了，夫君，对不起喔。」

「说什么对不起，你想开了就好，自己真的想开了，心里才会舒坦。」原平之能够感受到顾惜恩身上的宁静气息，与以往的焦躁截然不同，这让他真正松了口气。

看来，她是真的看开了。

顾惜恩深深吸了口气，犹豫了一会儿才说：「我以前也不是不信任你，可总是担心自己会重蹈母亲的悲剧，总忍不住会想，如果我生不了孩子，也许哪天你也会像父亲当年那样，偷偷地纳了什么女子，偷偷地去生儿子……一旦这样想，我就忍不住焦躁难过，就更加迫不及待地想自己生个孩子。」

原平之摸摸她的头，他其实多半能猜到她的心结，所以这么长时间才一直纵容着她，就怕她会钻牛角尖。

「我也想学人家贤慧妻子，主动为夫君纳妾生子，传承子嗣，连我父亲都写信劝过我，不要学我母亲那么霸道，不要步入母亲的后尘，只要我们感情深，就算收房纳妾了也没有什么大不了。」顾惜恩低声诉说着自己这几年的心理挣扎。「可是我做不到，我一想到别的女人和夫君在一起，心里就难受得很，我真是无可救药了吧？」
content_en:
It stands to reason that it has been five years since Gu Xien's miscarriage, she has just turned twenty, and Yuan Pingzhi is only twenty-eight. The couple still have enough time to wait for their next child.

But Gu Xien didn't think so. Her pressure was getting heavier every year. She was sad about the first child she had lost unintentionally, and she was eager to have a new baby to heal the scars in her heart. However, the more eager she was, the less likely she was to get pregnant.

Although Yuan Pingzhi also likes children, he is not so eager, but he no longer knows how to comfort his overly worried wife.

Yanjing original mansion.

Many of the main buildings of the new Yuan Mansion have not yet been built. Only the Wengluo Pavilion where Yuan Pingzhi and his wife lived were built first.

Yuan Pingzhi loved purple wisteria very much and transplanted many of them here. The new yard is still called Wisteria Pavilion, which somewhat alleviated Gu Xien's homesickness.

It was the late spring afternoon, and everyone who had eaten lunch was lazily. Gu Xien sat on the swing under the purple wisteria trellis, looking up at the sky, which was bluer than in the south.

She held a letter in her hand, which was sent to her by Gu Jinghong. Along with the letter was a large package of medicinal herbs and a folk prescription, a folk prescription for the woman to take care of her body, which was said to be beneficial to fertility.

After all, Gu Jinghong was too embarrassed to talk about this kind of thing in detail, so he only vaguely stated in the letter that this was a folk remedy that Gu Xien's grandmother had specifically sought out to treat Princess Shengping's years of infertility. Many noble ladies in Jinling had taken it, and it was said to be very effective.

However, Gu Xien knew that her grandmother had found this. It was simply a folk remedy that her father had specially searched for for her, right?Unexpectedly, her infertility had even alarmed Jinling and her father.

So, my parents-in-law must have been paying attention to it for a long time, right?Back then, my grandparents rejected my mother because she was still pregnant. So will my parents-in-law reject me now?Would they want to take in a house, take in concubines, and arrange for a new person for their husband?

Gu Xien had a headache thinking about it, and every time she thought about it, she felt sad for the women in the world, sad for her mother, and sad for herself.

What is the meaning of their lives?Just to get married and have children?Once you can't have children, especially if you can't have a son, will you become a trash that is spurned by others?

Now Gu Xi'en even feels lucky that she and Yuan Pingzhi are staying in Yanjing. They are far away from such a large family in Yuan Mansion. She doesn't have to face her parents-in-law every day, and she doesn't have to face her sisters-in-law with their children. Even if her parents-in-law are dissatisfied with her and her sisters-in-law pity her, she can just ignore them.

Qiu Shui and Qiu Yue accompanied Gu Xi'en. Qiu Shui was already the mother of two boys, and Qiu Yue also had a daughter. Her maids who were dowry back then have now become independent ladies in charge, and they have all become mothers.

Now Gu Xien even envies her maid.

Seeing that Gu Xi'en had been in a daze, Qiu Shui was a little anxious and said, "Young madam, now you don't even bother to take medicine. It's not an option to drag it out like this, right? Husband and wife, what do you mean by husband and wife? Husband and wife, close relatives and distant relatives, this is what I have heard from the eldest princess before.Poetry!The couple is really close if they live in the same house and sleep on the same bed. But if they are estranged, they are really estranged. If they are not married, they are just two strangers. Without blood ties, they are far away, and there is no limit to it."

Gu Xi'en rolled her eyes at her and said, "You have improved over the years, and your reasoning makes sense."

Qiu Shui chuckled. After giving birth to two children, she has gained weight, gained weight, and has become more outspoken and aggressive. In her own words, she said: "When I was a girl, I was very shy. When I was a daughter-in-law, I was a little shy. When I became a mother-in-law, I didn't know what shame was at all."

Gu Xien sometimes couldn't stand her behavior and warned her that even as a wife and mother, she should pay attention to her appearance and image, but she didn't care at all and still strode towards the image of a vulgar mature woman.

Chapter 10(2)

Qiuyue said: "You are getting more and more verbose. Say what you have to say directly. Don't talk so much."

Qiushui let out a long sigh and said, "It's true, this servant is also worried about the young lady. The world is like this now. If a mistress does not have a son by her side, life will be difficult. Do you see which backyard is not like this? If a concubine gives birth to a son, then life will be in dire straits."

Qiuyue frowned and said, "Stop it and tell the important point!"

"The key point is that the young lady must give birth to a son as soon as possible! If you don't have a son, you can have a daughter first. It will bloom first and then bear fruit. Anyway, there is a child first. This child belongs to the couple. Calling your mother and his father. Calling father and mother can make the couple's hearts sweeter than honey. Isn't the bond of blood already there? Wouldn't the relationship be closer? The couple no longer need to spend their days boringly staring at each other." Qiu Shui advised earnestly.

Qiuyue pinched her, this guy who thought he was smart, his long talk was all nonsense, how could their lady not want a child?

The problem is that Gu Xien can't get pregnant, so that's what we call sadness and despair, right?Now Qiushui is adding fuel to the fire, you are really looking for death!

After listening to her words, Gu Xien was silent for a long time, but suddenly smiled with relief: Qiu Shui was right, she was talking about the common situation of couples in the world, but there are always exceptions to everything, right?

Over the years, Yuan Pingzhi has been persuading her to relax. Not to mention that they are still young and still have plenty of time to have children. Even if they really can no longer have children, they already have a son, Yuan Jiaming, so what are they worried about?

Yes, what are you worried about?

People are always too greedy, which makes them troubled endlessly.

After the sudden realization, Gu Xien suddenly let go of her heavy psychological burden. She stood up with a smile and said, "Let's go back to the house."

When Yuan Pingzhi returned home in the evening, he heard that his wife had not only stopped all the decoctions, but also had spent the past few years

The lady won't be irritated, right?

Isn't it because he has gone crazy?

Before falling asleep, Yuan Pingzhi carefully observed Gu Xien and was very curious when he saw her calm expression and happy expression, which was rare in the past two years.

He put his arms around Gu Xi'en and asked with a smile: "Madam, do you want to work hard tonight?"

In order to get Gu Xien pregnant, he had to fight almost every night. It was very hard. If he continued like this, he was worried that he would suffer from premature aging.

Gu Xien got into his arms and refused apologetically, saying, "No, my husband has worked hard all day and needs a good rest."

Yuan Pingzhi secretly breathed a long sigh of relief, finally able to relax.

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

Yuan Pingzhi secretly thought, no wonder so many men look for extramarital affairs. Dealing with their wives can sometimes be really tiring both physically and mentally, making people want to escape.

"I heard that you stopped taking the decoction?" Yuan Pingzhi asked again.

"Yes." Gu Xi'en stretched her legs lazily, looking for a comfortable position in her husband's arms, and said, "I think about it, the imperial doctor said that my body has been recuperated and I don't need to take those messy folk remedies anymore. Instead of feeling uncomfortable, it's better to let nature take its course. For me, if you are destined to have a child, you will eventually have one, and there is no need to force yourself to have no child."

Yuan Pingzhi gently stroked her hair and asked, "Are you really thinking about it?"

"Really!" Gu Xi'en hugged him tightly and murmured, "I'm too willful to cause you to suffer too. Husband, I'm sorry."

"If you're sorry, just think about it. Only when you really think about it will you feel at ease." Yuan Pingzhi could feel the tranquility on Gu Xien's body, which was completely different from the anxiety in the past, which made him truly relieved.

It seemed that she really looked away.

Gu Xien took a deep breath and hesitated for a while before saying: "It's not that I didn't trust you before, but I was always worried that I would repeat my mother's tragedy. I couldn't help but think that if I couldn't give birth to a child, maybe one day you would secretly marry some woman and secretly give birth to a son like my father did... Once I think like this, I can't help but feel anxious and sad, and I can't wait to have a child myself."

Yuan Pingzhi touched her head. He could probably guess what was going on in her heart. That's why he had been indulging her for so long because he was afraid that she would get into trouble.

"I also want to be like other virtuous wives, take the initiative to take concubines and bear children for my husband, and pass on the heirs. Even my father wrote to me to persuade me not to be as domineering as my mother, and don't follow in her footsteps. As long as we have a deep relationship, it's not a big deal even if we take in concubines." Gu Xi'en whispered about her psychological struggle in the past few years."But I can't do it. When I think about other women being with my husband, I feel very uncomfortable. Am I really hopeless?"
